question: ttft
answer:
- **Time to first token (TTFT).** `stream_chat()` starts `time.perf_counter()` just before the HTTP request and measures seconds until the first streamed delta containing visible content or exposed reasoning. `_delta_text()` extracts both fields, and `stream_chat()` also records their first arrival times separately. [src/nvidia_ai/llm.py](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:97)
- **Tokens per second.** Both `ChatResult` properties use the provider-reported `completion_tokens`. `decode_tps` divides that count by `last_token_s - ttft_s`, the interval between the first and last deltas carrying content or reasoning. It omits samples below the minimum token count or generation duration. `e2e_tps` divides by `total_s`, the successful attempt’s wall time through stream close, including TTFT. Retry and backoff time is tracked separately in `observed_s` by `_with_retries()`. [src/nvidia_ai/llm.py](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:74) · [src/nvidia_ai/bench.py](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:111)
- **Reporting.** `_record()` saves the metrics per run. `summarize()` reports median TTFT across successful non-warmup runs and median TPS across successful runs of the designated throughput prompt. [src/nvidia_ai/bench.py](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:205)
